source_excerpts.text:
5. Separate optical and inventory models

The Raman source's two fitted doses provide an illustration only. If one
unwanted point accumulates n identical single-color exposures, each a fraction
epsilon of a selected exposure D, the introduced additive-dose model requires
  D>=0.239 J/cm2, n*epsilon*D<=2.225 J/cm2.
For n=10 and epsilon=1 it has no window; epsilon0.1 restores one. A real moving
light sheet may illuminate a point only once, while mixing, radical depletion,
bleaching or chemical reset change the accumulation law. No universal printing
failure, a printer power estimate or transfer to an exchange resin follows.

In a separate conditional inventory, if3% fresh additive per CURRENT batch is
retained each round without separation, mass grows as1.03^n:1.34392 after10 rounds,
19.2186 after100. This is not a reconstruction of the patent's complete species
balance; filtration, removal or genuinely regenerated initiator may change it.
Likewise, introduced stocks0.05 mol each of caged base and acid consumed at0.01 mol
per switching event permit only5 full open/close pairs absent replenishment or
regeneration. These are not measured source cycle limits. Repeated property
return, retained original polymer, low loss of every critical stock and an
economical closed material cycle must be established separately.
